description: Source code for SBC (Subband Codec) Bluetooth audio codec implementation, including configuration, encoding, decoding, and quality management.

classes.name: SBC
classes.description: Class implementing SBC Bluetooth audio codec with configuration, encoding, decoding, and quality management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures SBC codec based on stream format and settings.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves current SBC configuration as stream format and settings.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes supported or actual SBC capabilities into a stream.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes raw PCM frames into SBC frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes SBC frames into raw PCM frames.

methods.name: QOS
methods.description: Adjusts quality of service by modifying bitpool based on policy.

methods.name: Bitpool
methods.description: Sets the bitpool value for encoding.

methods.name: SBCConfigure
methods.description: Configures SBC parameters based on current settings.
